about.heading: About Me
about.body: Master of Science in Big Data candidate with over 5 years of corporate experience in data engineering and intelligent automation. Proven track record of designing robust ETL/ELT pipelines and developing enterprise-grade Power BI dashboards to drive business intelligence. Experienced in utilizing Python, SQL, and Azure to translate complex operational requirements into reliable data products. Brings direct experience developing RPA solutions for the banking sector, combined with a passion for implementing AI/ML-enabled data management to build organizational trust and streamline financial services.

items.title: GDELT Pipeline for Stock Prediction
items.problem: Predict stock prices from global event sentiment using years of GDELT data at scale.
items.systemDesign: Scalable pipeline on GCP with highly available infrastructure for ingesting and serving GDELT event data into a predictive ML workflow.
items.outcome: Processed 5 years of GDELT data to train a predictive ML model for stock prices based on global event sentiment.

items.title: TransLink Data Analysis — Power BI Dashboard
items.problem: Deliver reliable transit insights from TransLink data with maintainable ingestion and clear visualization.
items.systemDesign: Data Medallion architecture and Data Lake for reliable ingestion feeding Power BI dashboards.
items.outcome: Interactive dashboards using the TransLink data model to display operational insights.

items.title: chadbot — StormHacks Hackathon
items.problem: Provide real-time, data-driven LLM chat responses backed by structured data.
items.systemDesign: Dynamic chat interface with LangChain and SQL against a PostgreSQL database for live, data-backed answers.
items.outcome: Real-time, data-driven LLM responses through a dynamic chat interface.
